item.text: [{"task_id":"f1bcbc2c","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    wall = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    marker = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    paint = int(round(params['colors'][3]))","    moves = [(int(round(v[0])), int(round(v[1]))) for v in params['moves']]","    start_row = int(round(params['entry'][0]))","    h, w = grid.shape","    out = grid.copy()","    queue = []","    seen = set()","    if not (0 <= start_row < h):","        return out","    for c in range(w):","        left = c + moves[1][1]","        right = c + moves[2][1]","        if 0 <= left < w and 0 <= right < w:","            if grid[start_row, c] == background and grid[start_row, left] == wall and grid[start_row, right] == wall:","                queue.append((start_row, c))","    while queue:","        r, c = queue.pop()","        if (r, c) in seen:","            continue","        seen.add((r, c))","        value = grid[r, c]","        if value != background and value != marker:","            continue","        if value == marker:","            nr = r + moves[0][0]","            nc = c + moves[0][1]","            if not (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w):","                continue","            if grid[nr, nc] != background and grid[nr, nc] != marker:","                continue","        out[r, c] = paint","        for dr, dc in moves:","            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc","            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w:","                if (nr, nc) not in seen:","                    if grid[nr, nc] == background or grid[nr, nc] == marker:","                        queue.append((nr, nc))","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[4],"moves":[3,2],"entry":[1]},"params":{"colors":[0,7,9,8],"moves":[[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]],"entry":[0]},"rationale":"Blue flows from the upper corridor opening downward and sideways between orange walls. A maroon cell permits continued downward flow and is overwritten when that continuation exists; otherwise it stops the flow and remains maroon. Colors, flow directions, and entry boundary are encoded in the tensors."}]
